title: No ratchet row counts a package import nothing uses: 14 bound names in 6 modules are never loaded
claim: 14 names that 6 package modules bind with `from .<module> import N` are never loaded in the importing module, re-exported from it or named in a string of it, and adding a fifteenth moves none of the 18 rows of tests/structure.py.
mechanism: The dead censuses start at definitions (dead_top_level_symbols, dead_methods) and count loads; an import statement is neither, so a binding left behind when its last use went stays unseen. Each one is still an import edge: coordinator.py keeps edges to price_model (TIBBER_API_URL), dhw_learning (DHW_PROFILE_STORE_VERSION) and thermal_model (WATER_SPECIFIC_HEAT) by names it never reads, pump_arbiter.py to inputs.quantise_setpoint_c, optimizer.py to thermal_model.MIN_RUNNING_DRAW_KW and channel_heating_steps, and seven const names inflate const fan-out (thermal_model.py imports BUFFER_COOLING_RATE_MIN, BUFFER_COOLING_RATE_MAX and DEFAULT_BUFFER_COOLING_RATE and reads none). No lint lane in the tree reads them either (no ruff or flake8 configuration at the root).

evidence.contention_note: fan-out in progress, load1 about 199; a static count

perturbation.change: --perturb unused-import: in memory, `from .const import DOMAIN as _d7s1_unused` is appended to ledger.py. unused_package_imports rises 14 -> 15 and ratchet_rows_off_budget stays 0: measure() returns the budget table's 18 values unchanged.

metric_definition: Names bound by `from .<package module> import N` that the importer never loads, no module imports from it, and no string of it names. Key: (importer, name) and that name's loads there.
phenomenon_property: Every name a package module imports from another package module is loaded there, re-exported from there, or absent; a structural row falls when one is removed and refuses a new one.

null_control.note: the same appended import with one load of it is not counted: the census keys on the load, not on the statement

reproduction_steps: Run the harness: 14 UNUSED lines, RESULT unused_package_imports=14, RESULT ratchet_rows_off_budget=0.
Run it with --perturb unused-import: 15, and ratchet_rows_off_budget still 0.
Run it with --perturb use-import: 14 (the row that moves there, dead_top_level_symbols 1 -> 2, is the probe function itself).
proposed_fix_scope: Delete the bindings (each is one name on an import statement). No tests/*.py script reads 13 of them through the importer; the fourteenth, optimizer.channel_heating_steps, is imported from optimizer by tests/guard_pins.py:765, so that test moves to thermal_model with it. Give tests/structure.py a row for the census (the Package / import_bindings machinery already holds every binding and every load), recorded at 0.
